Those Builders are stunning us!|audio = TheFinalActWave5-1.ogg|[[Engineer (Narrator)|Engineer]] on Wave 5 ([[The Narratorium]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Builder''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium|Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had the highest health out of all enemies that appeared so far, but it was only as fast as the [[Attendee]]. It has one ability where it throws a brick at a tower or unit, which upon impact splits into three additional bricks. Any tower hit by them was stunned for 2 seconds while units received 150 damage. ==Logbook Description== "''The Builder is a creature created specifically to help the Narrator construct his grand visions. It handles all construction work, from laying foundations to adding decoration. The builder is only animated by a soul which Righty and Lefty can steal from a living being.''" ==Appearance== The '''Builder''' is a plushie with a yellow head, black legs and arms, and an orange torso. On its torso, it has a zipper while on its head it wears a yellow and blue hard hat. It has two black button eyes and a giant open mouth with a visible tongue. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, the '''Builder''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} BuilderWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) BuilderBrickThrow.gif|''Cluster Brick'' animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseBuilder.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} BuilderIconIG.png|'''Builder''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Builder''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Builder''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Builder''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Sack Noob]] & [[Extra A]]|Wave 4|Builder|Wave 5|[[Extra B]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
